This '''list of [[statistician]]s''' lists people who have made notable contributions to the theories or application of [[statistics]], or to the related fields of [[probability]] or [[machine learning]]. It includes the [[founders of statistics]] and others. It includes some 17th- and 18th-century [[mathematician]]s and [[polymath]]s whose work is regarded as influential in shaping the later discipline of statistics. Also included are various [[actuary|actuaries]], [[economist]]s, and [[demography|demographers]] known for providing leadership in applying statistics to their fields.
